high.title: Full-Stack Developer — AI-Native Engineering
high.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

We are seeking an agile, end-to-end Full-Stack Developer to own the technical execution, rapid prototyping, and release lifecycle of our next-generation pre-sales scoping and estimation tool. As a core member of a lean engineering team, you will act as a "Full Stack" specialist, carrying direct responsibility for the entire application development lifecycle—spanning frontend construction, backend service integration, database configuration, deployment, and comprehensive quality assurance testing. Working under the guidance of the Technical Architect, you will leverage cutting-edge AI-augmented developer workflows to translate low-level designs into responsive web interfaces featuring embedded Claude plugin agents that securely interact with distributed systems.

Key Responsibilities



- Rapid POC Implementation: Collaborate closely with the Technical Architect to quickly transform stakeholder requirements into functional, interactive Proof of Concepts (POCs) and operational prototypes.
- Design Execution & Modular Coding: Take ownership of Low-Level Designs (LLDs), converting software specifications into clean, maintainable, and highly modular code blocks utilizing modern JavaScript frameworks.
- Agent Embedded Development: Develop web-based application tiers featuring embedded Claude plugin agents. Implement unified cross-system data bridges using Model Context Protocol (MCP) to allow background reasoning loops to fetch context securely from external enterprise systems.
- API Integration & Authentication: Develop and consume robust RESTful services. Configure and execute precise authentication workflows supporting safe data transmission, strictly adhering to OAuth variants (including Username-Password flow, Web Server flow, and JWT flow).
- Database Management & Persistence: Design, optimize, and maintain relational or specialized database structures to provide optimal data persistence for scoping configurations and real-time computation states.
- CI/CD Pipeline Maintenance: Commit code, manage version control histories via Git, and interact with automated Jenkins build jobs to deploy software securely across SaaS platforms like Heroku.
- Quality Assurance & E2E Testing: Write and execute comprehensive unit, integration, and user-acceptance test profiles to maintain software stability within an accelerated, high-yield iteration cycle.

Required Experience & Skills



- Professional Experience: Strong foundation in full-stack software development with explicit experience building and deploying multi-tier web applications from scratch.
- Advanced Web Framework Proficiency: Exceptional capability in Advanced JavaScript / TypeScript combined with operational mastery of web environments like Node.js, React, or AngularJS.
- AI Integration & Tooling Command: Practical experience consuming LLM APIs, prompt tracking, and integrating agentic plugins. Expert command of modern AI-augmented coding toolchains (such as Cursor or Claude Code) to accelerate feature shipping is highly valued.
- API and Security Foundations: Firm comprehension of REST architecture, relational database indexing, and common security authorization token exchanges (OAuth, JWT).
- DevOps and Lifecycle Discipline: Practical familiarity managing collaborative repositories using Git, navigating automated Jenkins pipelines, and hosting application artifacts on SaaS infrastructures like Heroku.

Desired Experience & Certifications



- Background or technical familiarity with the Force.com infrastructure (Apex, Lightning Web Components, Data Cloud) is highly advantageous but not mandatory.
- Familiarity with Markdown documentation and grounding strategies for Large Language Models.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

high.title: Software Engineer 2
high.description:
Overview

Schoology, a PowerSchool Unified ClassroomTM Product, one of the fastest growing education technology companies, is putting collaboration at the heart of the learning experience with an easy-to-use learning management system (LMS) that connects the people, content and systems that fuel education. Millions of students, faculty and administrators from over 60,000 K-12 schools and higher education institutions worldwide use Schoology to advance what is possible in education. This is more important than ever in a post COVID world. Schoology is here to support the online and in person learning schools face today. We are looking for a strong candidate to help deliver that vision. Working at Schoology offers you a chance to help solve the most important challenges in education at scale in an environment that's fun, collaborative, and innovative. We are looking for smart, creative individuals who are passionate about education and are not afraid to show it.

Team Overview

Our Research & Development (R&D) team is the technical talent at the heart of our product suite, overseeing the product development lifecycle from concept to delivery. From engineering to quality assurance to data science, the R&D team ensures our customers seamlessly use our products and can depend on their consistency.

Responsibilities



-  Description 



The Schoology Software Engineering team is a group of full stack developers who design, develop, and maintain our products, tools, and infrastructure.

Your day-to-day job will consist of:



-  Designing, developing, and maintaining scalable backend services and APIs using PHP (CodeIgniter/Laravel) and Node.js 
-  Building and enhancing frontend features using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript 
-  Developing and operating microservices in a multi-tenant, distributed environment 
-  Working with MySQL/Aurora, MongoDB, and Redis to design efficient data models and optimize performance 
-  Deploying, monitoring, and troubleshooting services on AWS, using Docker and Kubernetes 
-  Collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions 
-  Using AI Agents, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot to improve development velocity, code quality, and problem solving 
-  Contributing to system design discussions, proofs of concept, and continuous improvement of engineering practices 



Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications



- Minimum of 2–5 years of relevant and related work experience.
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, or equivalent years of relevant work experience.



Preferred Qualifications



- 2–5 years of relevant software engineering experience.
- Strong backend development experience with PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js.
- Experience building microservices and APIs in multi-tenant environments, with a understanding of distributed systems, software design principles and patterns.
- Experience with MySQL/Aurora, MongoDB, and Redis.
- Good to have experience with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS services, and CI/CD pipelines, including build and deployment processes.
- Experience building prototypes and proof-of-concepts (PoCs).
- Hands-on experience with AI agents and AI-powered development tools such as Cursor and GitHub Copilot.



Soft Skills



- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
- Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions
- Clear communication with engineers and non-technical stakeholders
- Strong ownership mindset and collaboration skills



 EEO Commitment 

EEO Commitment

PowerSchool is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. PowerSchool is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers PowerSchoolers to deliver the best results for our customers. We not only celebrate the diversity of our workforce, we celebrate the diverse ways we work. If you have a disability and need an accommodation regarding our recruiting process, please let us know by emailing accommodations@powerschool.com.

medium.description:
Position Title

Full Stack Integration Developer

Experience

3+ Years (relevant experience in Full Stack and Backend Development)

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Developer with strong expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, AWS Serverless technologies, and modern application architecture. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable, high-performance applications while working across both backend and frontend components. The role requires hands-on experience in cloud-native development, event-driven architectures, API design, data streaming, and database optimization.

The candidate should be capable of owning solutions end-to-end, from architecture and design through development, deployment, monitoring, and production support.

Key Responsibilities



- Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performing full-stack applications.
- Build and manage serverless applications using AWS services and best practices.
- Develop and maintain RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
- Design and implement event-driven architectures and data streaming solutions using Apache Kafka.
- Develop reusable frontend components and integrate them with backend services.
- Design, optimize, and maintain relational and NoSQL databases.
- Implement ETL and data transformation pipelines for large-scale systems.
- Participate in end-to-end system design, including scalability, reliability, performance, and security considerations.
- Monitor application health, troubleshoot production issues, and improve system observability.
- Collaborate with product managers, architects, QA teams, and other stakeholders to deliver robust solutions.
- Follow coding standards, perform code reviews, and ensure high-quality software delivery.
- Contribute to CI/CD automation and deployment strategies.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Backend Development



- Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js.
- Hands-on experience developing scalable backend services.
- Strong understanding of asynchronous programming and modern architectural patterns.
- Experience building microservices-based applications.

Cloud & AWS Services

Hands-on Experience With



- AWS Lambda
- API Gateway
- Amazon S3
- Amazon SQS
- Amazon SNS
- Amazon MSK (Managed Kafka)
- Amazon CloudWatch
- AWS Secrets Manager

Serverless Architecture



- Proven experience building and deploying Serverless applications.
- Familiarity with Serverless Framework, AWS SAM, or equivalent tools.
- Strong understanding of cloud-native application design principles.

Data & Streaming



- Strong experience with Apache Kafka and distributed messaging systems.
- Understanding of event-driven architecture and real-time data processing.
- Experience with ETL pipelines and stream processing concepts.
- Knowledge of data transformation and integration patterns.

Database Technologies

Experience With



- MySQL
- MongoDB

Strong Understanding Of



- Database design and data modeling
- Query optimization
- Indexing strategies
- Performance tuning
- Data integrity and scalability

API Development

Expertise In



- RESTful API design principles
- GraphQL development
- API versioning and documentation
- API security using OAuth2, JWT, and authentication best practices
- API performance optimization

System Design & Architecture



- Ability to design large-scale distributed systems.
- Deep understanding of:

- Microservices Architecture
- Distributed Systems
- High Availability
- Fault Tolerance
- Resiliency Patterns
- Scalability and Performance Optimization
- Experience conducting architecture reviews and design discussions.
Frontend Development



- Experience with modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
- Strong understanding of responsive UI development.
- Experience integrating frontend applications with REST/GraphQL APIs.
- Knowledge of state management, component-based architecture, and frontend performance optimization.

Preferred Qualifications



- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
- Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes.
- Knowledge of monitoring, logging, and observability best practices.
- Experience working on high-traffic or real-time applications.
- Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies.
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation is an added advantage.

Educational Qualification

Minimum Qualification Required



- B.Tech / B.E. / M.Sc. in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related discipline.

The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in programming, problem-solving, and software development fundamentals, along with a willingness to learn new technologies and contribute to real-world engineering projects.
You will work closely with experienced engineers to design, develop, test, debug, and maintain scalable software applications.

- Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications based on business requirements.
- Write clean, efficient, maintainable, and reusable code.
- Collaborate with senior engineers, product managers, and QA teams to deliver high-quality software.
- Participate in code reviews and follow established coding standards and best practices.
- Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects and technical issues.
- Develop and integrate APIs and work with databases.

- Write unit tests and support application testing and debugging.
- Stay updated with emerging technologies, development tools, and software engineering practices.

- Basic knowledge of object-oriented programming (OOP) concepts.
- Familiarity with SQL and relational databases.
- Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and software testing fundamentals.
- Basic knowledge of REST APIs and web development concepts.
- Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
- Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team.
- Willingness to learn, adapt, and work with new technologies.


Preferred Qualifications



- Internship experience or academic project experience in software development.
- Familiarity with frameworks such as Spring Boot, React, Angular, Django, or similar technologies.
- Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
- Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Docker, or automated testing tools.
- Contributions to GitHub projects or participation in coding competitions.


What We Offer

- Opportunities to work on real-world software engineering projects.
- Mentorship and technical guidance from experienced engineers.
- Exposure to modern technologies and development practices.
- A collaborative environment that encourages innovation and continuous learning.
- Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.


Ideal Candidate Profile
We are looking for candidates who demonstrate:

- A strong foundation in computer science and programming.
- A passion for building software and solving technical challenges.
- A proactive attitude toward learning and problem-solving.
- The ability to take ownership of assigned tasks and deliver results.
- A commitment to writing quality code and continuously improving technical skills.

stretch.description:
Summary

Guidewire is searching for a full stack engineer who is passionate about all things data, from polishing data under the hood to visualizing complex data sets in mind blowing ways. You will help build our next generation of data analytics and visualization tools to help insurance companies glean actionable insights into their operational performance.

Job Description

Who You Are

You are an enthusiastic engineer who is passionate about building high-quality software with a great team and improving the customer experience for all of our customers who use our products every day. You have a fine attention to detail and love visualizing data in all forms. You can quickly build new features in an agile environment. You are a self-starter and able to perform with minimal supervision while working alongside intelligent colleagues who've checked their egos at the door in a team environment, communicating effectively with everyone. We've built a strong culture, and we're looking for engineers who can help us maintain it!

Responsibilities

Technical mastery



- Build an impactful, performant, and scalable stack and unified application that fear no challenge
- Write production code to lead our developers from the front

Execution



- Deliver quantified business outcomes for customers with products that deliver the future today and make us proud
- Build trust via transparency, communication, and consistent delivery that is on-scope and with outstanding quality

Qualifications



- 6 to 8 years’ experience in cloud native development
- Proficient with Core Java and frameworks like Spring/Spring Boot
- Proficient with JavaScript and its standards along with MVC frameworks like React or Angular
- Experience in working with AI tools and understanding of effective Agentic AI development patterns
- Proficient with HTML5 and CSS3, including frameworks similar to Bootstrap or Material
- Experience with AWS (S3, SQS, Redshift), Kubernetes, Docker
- Experience with databases and SQL, particularly PostgreSQL
- Experience with data visualization libraries such as D3.js or Google Charts
- Familiarity with Node.js and associated frameworks, like Express.js 

About Guidewire

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.

For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire_PandC.

stretch.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (React + Node)
stretch.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

About Company

Fractal is a leading AI and analytics company that helps global enterprises turn data into decisions at scale. We are looking for a hands-on Senior Full Stack Engineer with 6+ years of experience to design, build, and scale enterprise-grade digital products across front-end, back-end, APIs, cloud, DevOps, and AI-enabled application layers. This role requires strong engineering ownership, practical design thinking, and the ability to deliver secure, reliable, and high-performing solutions in collaboration with architects, TPMs, and cross-functional teams.

Role Brief

You will own critical feature implementation across web applications, APIs, integrations, cloud-native services, and AI-powered capabilities. The role combines deep hands-on engineering with practical participation in technical design, code quality, performance optimization, and operational excellence.

You will work closely with architects, TPMs, product managers, QA engineers, DevOps engineers, designers, and peer developers to translate solution intent into scalable, maintainable, and production-ready systems.

Key Responsibilities Include



- Develop robust, efficient, and maintainable code for critical features, ensuring both functional and non-functional requirements are met.
- Participate in system and solution design discussions, contributing practical implementation insights, technical trade-offs, and pseudo-code where needed.
- Act as a technical point of contact for day-to-day implementation issues, troubleshoot challenges quickly, and drive timely resolution.
- Enforce and improve code quality through code reviews, engineering standards, automated testing, and secure development practices.
- Collaborate closely with architects, TPMs, product teams, and platform teams to translate high-level designs and AI use cases into scalable, secure, and production-ready solutions.
- Build and integrate AI-powered application capabilities such as copilots, intelligent assistants, summarization, search, recommendations, and workflow augmentation using LLM APIs and related services where relevant.
- Implement AI-enabled solution patterns including prompt orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), grounding strategies, structured outputs, tool or function calling, and quality or safety guardrails for enterprise use cases.
- Support and improve DevOps practices including build pipelines, CI/CD workflows, automated testing, release readiness, and engineering observability.
- Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize application, system, and AI feature performance in line with project objectives, reliability expectations, latency targets, and cost considerations.
- Document technical designs, implementation decisions, and operational considerations to support maintainability, auditability, and knowledge transfer.
- Mentor junior engineers by sharing best practices, reviewing work products, and guiding them on sound engineering approaches.
- Contribute to technical proposals, estimations, reusable assets, and implementation improvements including automation, refactoring, and component reuse.
- Maintain compliance with security, quality, governance, and audit expectations, and contribute to broader process and capability improvement initiatives within CDT.


Must Have



- 6+ years of hands-on experience building enterprise-grade full-stack applications, with strong ownership of complex engineering workstreams from design through delivery.
- Strong expertise in one or more modern front-end frameworks such as React, along with solid command of JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
- Strong back-end engineering experience in at least one major stack such as Python (FastAPI, Django, Flask), Node.js (Express, NestJS, or similar).
- Strong understanding of system design fundamentals, design patterns, API design, scalability, reliability, performance optimization, and distributed application architecture.
- Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, or similar, including schema design and query performance tuning.
- Hands-on experience building and consuming REST APIs and working with modern integration patterns across services and external systems.
- Strong understanding of responsive web design, reusable component-based architecture, accessibility basics, and front-end performance optimization.
- Hands-on experience with automated testing practices including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing using tools such as Jest, PyTest, Playwright, Cypress, or equivalent.
- Working experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, including deployment, configuration, observability, and support for cloud-native environments.
- Hands-on experience with containerization and modern engineering environments using tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, or equivalent platforms.
- Strong understanding of DevOps and secure SDLC practices including CI/CD pipelines, source control workflows, code reviews, build automation, and release quality controls.
- Hands-on experience integrating AI capabilities into applications, including LLM APIs, prompt design, structured outputs, tool or function calling, and building reliable user-facing AI features.
- Good understanding of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, grounding strategies, prompt orchestration, and common GenAI failure modes such as hallucination and response inconsistency.
- Experience implementing evaluation, monitoring, and guardrails for AI-enabled features, including response quality checks, fallback handling, latency and cost awareness, and privacy or security considerations for enterprise use cases.
- Ability to translate solution architecture into detailed implementation plans and contribute effectively to technical design discussions with architects and engineering leads.
- Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills, with the ability to rapidly resolve production and implementation issues while maintaining engineering quality.
- Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to engineering best practices, reusable assets, and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional and client-facing delivery environments.


Nice to Have



- Experience working in Agile delivery environments with close collaboration across product, QA, DevOps, TPM, and architecture teams.

stretch.title: Python and AI/ML Developer
stretch.description:
Role Overview


Are you excited about the future of AI and how it can revolutionize network infrastructure? We are looking for an enthusiastic Python and AI/ML Developer to help us build the next generation of AI-powered solutions for network operations, automation, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
In this role, you’ll get the unique opportunity to blend backend development with practical networking concepts, machine learning, and cutting-edge Generative AI. If you love solving complex puzzles and want to see your code make a real-world impact, we want to meet you!


Company: Terralogic Software Solutions Pvt Ltd
Experience: 0 - 2 years (Perfect for motivated freshers or early-career pros!)
Location: Bangalore (In-office)


Technologies You’ll Work With & Build Upon
The Core Essentials (What you bring to the table):

- Python & Backend Mastery: Strong foundational skills in Python for building production-ready applications, automated scripts, and neat integrations. You should feel comfortable developing RESTful APIs using FastAPI and have an understanding of microservices and scalable backend systems.
- AI/ML & Generative AI Curiosity: Hands-on projects or experience with Machine Learning, NLP, Transformers, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
- The Future of AI Agents: Familiarity or experience building multi-agent workflows using frameworks like Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, or similar tools. Any knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication is a massive plus!
- Data & Model Evaluation: Comfort with preparing data, evaluating models, and smoothly integrating AI/ML capabilities into real-world applications.


Bonus Points (Nice-to-haves—don't worry if you don't have them all!):

- Networking certifications like CCNA, CCNP, or DevNet.
- Experience with Cisco pyATS/Genie for network testing and validation.
- A passion for applying AI/ML to cool use cases like anomaly detection, time-series forecasting, or root-cause analysis.
- Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, reranking, and RAG evaluation.


Your Journey & Responsibilities
As a valued member of our growing team, you will learn, adapt, and drive impact by:

- Owning Your Work: Delivering high-quality code on time, collaborating openly with your teammates, and growing through constructive feedback.
- Building Scalable Systems: Designing and deploying reliable, secure, and high-performance backend microservices and APIs using Python and FastAPI.
- Innovating in AI & Networking: Crafting AI/ML solutions for network health analysis, incident classification, and troubleshooting assistants.
- Developing Smart Agents: Building AI agents that can handle network diagnostics and talk to each other seamlessly using MCP/A2A frameworks.
- Automating Infrastructure: Writing smart Python workflows for device discovery, automated configuration checks, and pre/post-change validation.
- Handling Data Pipelines: Engineering pipelines that ingest, normalize, and analyze massive amounts of network logs, telemetry, and event data.
- Ensuring Security & Excellence: Implementing smart access controls and audit logs for AI-assisted actions, while constantly troubleshooting, optimizing performance, and maintaining automated tests.


Why Join Terralogic?


This is a rare opportunity for a developer early in their career to work directly with highly advanced GenAI Agentic workflows and network automation frameworks. You won't just be a cog in a machine—with a cohort of 10 people starting together, you will have a direct support system, mentorship, and a platform to fast-track your technical skills.
Ready to build the future of AI-driven networks? Apply today and let's grow together!
